peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 4% below its local comparables; 64 of 130 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (80.3): 4.8 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 312 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 7). Context, not scored: resales in 25% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $2,300,000 ($2,348 psf, 947–990 sq ft; 5 resales, Oct 2024–Sep 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,447 psf (range $1,968–3,072); 4% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $97,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Tanjong Pagar MRT about 370 m, Cantonment MRT about 400 m; closer than 460 of 662 similar developments (the same as 7). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 1 within 2 km; nearest Zhangde Primary School about 1,990 m; more than 0 of 662 similar developments (the same as 125). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 6 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 180 m), more than 207 of 662 similar developments (the same as 35); nearest hawker centre Blk 6 Tanjong Pagar Plaza Market And Food Centre about 210 m; nearest park Duxton Plain Park about 140 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Blk 6 Tanjong Pagar Plaza Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Newport Residences, 203 new sales, about 350 m; TMW Maxwell, 1 new sales, about 540 m; Skywaters Residences, 5 new sales, about 630 m; W Residences Marina View - Singapore, 14 new sales, about 920 m; Union Square Residences, 106 new sales, about 1,400 m; Canninghill Piers, 8 new sales, about 1,820 m; The Robertson Opus, 40 new sales, about 1,820 m; Zyon Grand, 637 new sales, about 1,890 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 77 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,014 new sales and 492 resales (1,506 purchases); new sales were 67.3% of these purchases. Subsales (33) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 492 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 110 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 492 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 590 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−16.6%). Observed transactions, not a prediction.
